messages:
jamal: Hey team — can we add a new Grafana dashboard that correlates per-tenant GPU power capping, fan RPM anomalies, and network rx/tx microbursts? Want a single "exposure" view so SRE + Support can quickly see which tenant/region combos are hitting power caps and showing thermal or net side-effects.

sara: +1. super useful for triage. do you mean tenant-level rollups and also drill-down to instance slots? :+1:

leo: yeah — suggest templating variables: $region, $tenant, $slot. Panels I'd start with:
- power cap vs observed power (timeseries)
- util% vs power (2-axis)
- fan RPM heatmap (rack x time)
- network rx/tx spikes (overlay)
- recent reboots/evictions table (annotation layer)

maya: love it. for the fan heatmap we should bucket by inlet temp too so we don't chase normal high-RPM during hot racks. and add an annotation for any powercap changes.

leo: quick PromQL snippets for panel queries (first cut):
```
# avg observed power (5m) per tenant
avg(avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts{job="gpu_exporter",tenant="$tenant"}[5m])) by (instance)

# power cap (5m) per tenant
avg(avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_cap_watts{job="gpu_exporter",tenant="$tenant"}[5m])) by (instance)

# fan rpm heatmap per rack
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_fan_rpm{job="gpu_exporter"}[10m]) by (rack,slot)
```

jamal: nice. For alerting, propose an alert: if observed power < 0.8 * cap AND gpu_utilization > 70% for 5m then paged to infra oncall. Something like: 
```
alert: PowerCappedButBusy
expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]) < 0.8 * avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_cap_watts{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]) and avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization_gpu{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]) > 70
for: 5m
```
(suggestion, can refine threshold per region)

sara: can we also add a derived panel that estimates energy cost per-tenant for the selected window? That would help chargebacks. simple conversion Watt -> Wh -> $ using region pricing var.

maya: yep — we can add a dashboard var $energy_rate_usd_per_kwh and compute: sum(rate power * 1h) * $energy_rate / 1000. example PromQL (estimate Wh over range):
```
# rough Wh per instance over range (sum of per-minute avg * 1/60 h)
sum_over_time(avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_watts{tenant="$tenant"}[1m])[1h:1m]) / 60
```
We'll convert Wh->kWh and multiply by $energy_rate_usd_per_kwh in the panel unit.

leo: small UX ask: add a quick-filter dropdown for "show only instances with recent power cap change" and only show rows with annotation within last 30m. saves clicking.

jamal: sounds good. i'll draft the panel JSONs and a short README for how to interpret the exposure view. plan: create PR to dashboards repo, link panels to alert rules in ops/prometheus.

maya: I'll own templating vars + unit conversions, and I'll add inlet-temp buckets. @opsguy-bot can you import the draft after PR merges? :rocket: 

opsguy-bot: queued dashboard import after merge. will validate panel schemas and run linter. :robot_face: 

sara: cool — can we also add one compact panel that shows "actionable next steps" for oncall: e.g. if power cap event -> check tenant quota, check cooling, escalate to capacity planning. small doc link in panel.

jamal: yes. I'll add a short checklist and link to runbook. tagging this as FYI for support and capacity planning. thanks all :eyes:
